license_required.quote: A person may not engage in the practice of physical therapy, unless the person is: (1) licensed under this chapter and practices within the scope of that license; or (2) exempted from the licensing requirements of this chapter under Section 58-1-307 or 58-24b-304.
license_required.citation: Section 301 - Authority to practice physical therapy.

issuing_authority.value: Division of Professional Licensing, in consultation with the Physical Therapies Licensing Board
issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the Physical Therapies Licensing Board, created in Section 58-24b-201.

name.quote: "Board" means the Physical Therapies Licensing Board, created in Section 58-24b-201.

type.quote: "Board" means the Physical Therapies Licensing Board, created in Section 58-24b-201.

umbrella_agency.value: Division of Professional Licensing, Department of Commerce
umbrella_agency.quote: There is created within the Department of Commerce the Division of Professional Licensing. The division shall administer and enforce all licensing laws of Title 58, Occupations and Professions.
umbrella_agency.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act

degree_required.value: Graduation from an accredited professional physical therapist education program
degree_required.quote: submit proof of graduation from a professional physical therapist education program that is accredited by a recognized accreditation agency

accrediting_body.value: Recognized accreditation agency (approved by the division, in consultation with the board)
accrediting_body.quote: "Recognized accreditation agency" means an accreditation agency that: (a) grants accreditation, nationally, in the United States of America; and (b) is approved by the division, in consultation with the board.

required.quote: An applicant for a license as a physical therapist shall: (a) complete the application process, including payment of fees; (b) submit proof of graduation from a professional physical therapist education program that is accredited by a recognized accreditation agency; (c) pass a licensing examination

exams.name: Licensing Examination (nationally recognized physical therapy examination)
exams.notes: Approved by the division, in consultation with the board; may be taken in final term of program
exams.quote: "Licensing examination" means a nationally recognized physical therapy examination that is approved by the division, in consultation with the board.

interval_years.quote: A license issued under this chapter shall be issued in accordance with a two-year renewal cycle established by rule.
interval_years.citation: Section 303 - Term of license -- Renewal -- Temporary license for physical therapist assistant.

required.quote: At the time of license renewal, the licensee shall provide satisfactory evidence that the licensee completed continuing education competency requirements, established by the division, by rule.
required.citation: Section 303 - Term of license -- Renewal -- Temporary license for physical therapist assistant.

period_years.quote: A license issued under this chapter shall be issued in accordance with a two-year renewal cycle established by rule.
period_years.citation: Section 303 - Term of license -- Renewal -- Temporary license for physical therapist assistant.

available.quote: The division shall issue a license to an individual who holds a current unrestricted license to practice physical therapy in a state, district, or territory of the United States of America, other than Utah, if the individual: (a) completes the application process, including payment of fees

requirements.value: Must hold a current unrestricted license in another US state/territory, complete application, demonstrate English proficiency if requested, pass criminal background check, and meet any other division requirements.
requirements.quote: The division shall issue a license to an individual who holds a current unrestricted license to practice physical therapy in a state, district, or territory of the United States of America, other than Utah

national_association.citation: Section 401 - Authority and ethical standards of a licensed physical therapist and licensed physical therapist assistant -- Function of a physical therapy aide.

is_mandatory.citation: Section 301 - Authority to practice physical therapy.

title_protection.quote: representing oneself as, or using the title of, a physical therapist, unless the person is: (a) a licensed physical therapist

scope_protection.quote: practicing physical therapy, unless the person: (a) is licensed under this chapter to practice physical therapy and practices within the scope of that license; or (b) is exempt from licensure under Section 58-24b-304

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing physical therapy without a license or outside the scope of the license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practicing physical therapy, unless the person: (a) is licensed under this chapter to practice physical therapy and practices within the scope of that license; or (b) is exempt from licensure under Section 58-24b-304

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing animal physical therapy without proper authorization
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practicing animal physical therapy, unless the person is: (a) authorized to practice animal physical therapy under Section 58-24b-405; or (b) authorized to practice animal physical therapy under Subsection 58-24b-304(1)(a), (2), or (3)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing oneself as or using the title of physical therapist without being licensed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: representing oneself as, or using the title of, a physical therapist, unless the person is: (a) a licensed physical therapist

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing oneself as or using the title of physical therapist assistant without being licensed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: representing oneself as, or using the title of, a physical therapist assistant, unless the person: (a) is a licensed physical therapist assistant

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using or employing services of an individual to assist a licensee in a manner not in accordance with recognized practices, standards, or ethics, or requirements of the chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: using or employing the services of an individual to assist a person licensed under this chapter in a manner that is not in accordance with: (a) generally recognized practices, standards, or ethics of the profession for which the person is licensed; or (b) the requirements of this chapter or rule

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to confine conduct to what the licensee is competent to perform and within the scope of practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure by a person licensed under this chapter to confine the person's conduct to that which: (a) the person is competent to perform, by education, training, and experience; and (b) is within the scope of practice permitted under this chapter or rule

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to supervise a licensed physical therapist assistant or physical therapy aide in accordance with requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to supervise a licensed physical therapist assistant or a physical therapy aide in accordance with the requirements of this chapter or rule

disciplinary_grounds.description: Division may refuse to issue, refuse to renew, revoke, suspend, restrict, place on probation, or issue reprimand
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the division may: (1) refuse to issue a license to an applicant; (2) refuse to renew a license; (3) revoke, suspend, or restrict a license; (4) place a license on probation; (5) issue a public or private reprimand to a licensee; or (6) issue a cease and desist order.
disciplinary_grounds.citation: Section 305 - License denial -- Discipline -- Cease and desist order.

definition_quote.value: "Physical therapy" or "physiotherapy" means: (i) examining, evaluating, and testing an individual who has a physical impairment or injury; (ii) identifying or labeling a physical impairment or injury; (iii) formulating a therapeutic intervention plan for the treatment of a physical impairment, injury, or pain; (iv) assessing the ongoing effects of therapeutic intervention for the treatment of a physical impairment or injury; (v) treating or alleviating a physical impairment by designing, modifying, or implementing a therapeutic intervention; (vi) reducing the risk of an injury or physical impairment; (vii) providing instruction on the use of physical measures, activities, or devices for preventative and therapeutic purposes; (viii) promoting and maintaining health and fitness; (ix) the administration of a prescription drug pursuant to Section 58-24b-403
definition_quote.quote: "Physical therapy" or "physiotherapy" means: (i) examining, evaluating, and testing an individual who has a physical impairment or injury; (ii) identifying or labeling a physical impairment or injury; (iii) formulating a therapeutic intervention plan for the treatment of a physical impairment, injury, or pain

drug_authority.quote: A licensed physical therapist may purchase, store, and administer topical and aerosol medications that require a prescription only as provided in this section.
drug_authority.citation: Section 403 - Administration of a prescription drug.

direct_access_allowed.quote: A physical therapist may evaluate, initiate, and provide physical therapy treatment for a client without a referral from another health service provider.
direct_access_allowed.citation: Section 307 - No referral required for physical therapy.

pta_license_required.quote: "Licensed physical therapist assistant" means a person licensed under this chapter to engage in the practice of physical therapy, subject to the provisions of Subsection 58-24b-401(2)(a).

pta_supervision_type_required.quote: A licensed physical therapist assistant: (a) is authorized to practice physical therapy: (i) under the on-site supervision or general supervision of a licensed physical therapist
pta_supervision_type_required.citation: Section 401 - Authority and ethical standards of a licensed physical therapist and licensed physical therapist assistant -- Function of a physical therapy aide.

aide_role_defined.quote: "Physical therapy aide" means a person who: (a) is trained, on-the-job, by a licensed physical therapist; and (b) provides routine assistance to a licensed physical therapist or licensed physical therapist assistant

value: on-site supervision of licensed physical therapist
on-site supervision of licensed physical therapist assistant
general or on-site supervision of licensed physical therapist
aide_supervision_type_required.quote: a physical therapy aide may provide routine assistance to: (i) a licensed physical therapist while the licensed physical therapist engages in the practice of physical therapy, if the physical therapy aide is under the on-site supervision of the licensed physical therapist; or (ii) a licensed physical therapist assistant while the licensed physical therapist assistant engages in the practice of physical therapy, within the scope of the licensed physical therapist assistant's license, if the physical therapy aide is: (A) under the general or on-site supervision of a licensed physical therapist; and (B) under the on-site supervision of the licensed physical therapist assistant.
aide_supervision_type_required.citation: Section 401 - Authority and ethical standards of a licensed physical therapist and licensed physical therapist assistant -- Function of a physical therapy aide.

design a plan of care for a patient
perform the joint mobilization component of manual therapy
perform the sharp selective debridement component of wound management
pta_restricted_procedures.quote: A physical therapist assistant or a physical therapy aide may not: (a) perform a physical therapy evaluation or assessment; (b) identify or label a physical impairment or injury; (c) design a plan of care for a patient; (d) perform the joint mobilization component of manual therapy; or (e) perform the sharp selective debridement component of wound management.

trigger_point_dry_needling_authorized.quote: A physical therapist may practice trigger point dry needling if the physical therapist: (a) has a valid license to practice physical therapy under this chapter
trigger_point_dry_needling_authorized.citation: Section 306 - Trigger point dry needling -- Experience required -- Registration.

trigger_point_dry_needling_course_hours.quote: at least 304 total course hours, including at a minimum of: (A) 54 hours of in-person instruction; and (B) 250 supervised patient treatment hours
trigger_point_dry_needling_course_hours.citation: Section 306 - Trigger point dry needling -- Experience required -- Registration.

trigger_point_dry_needling_registration_.quote: registers with the division as a trigger point dry needling practitioner
trigger_point_dry_needling_registration_.citation: Section 306 - Trigger point dry needling -- Experience required -- Registration.

animal_physical_therapy_authorized.quote: a licensed physical therapist may practice animal physical therapy if the licensed physical therapist completes at least 100 hours of animal physical therapy training and education

animal_physical_therapy_training_hours.quote: a licensed physical therapist may practice animal physical therapy if the licensed physical therapist completes at least 100 hours of animal physical therapy training and education

animal_physical_therapy_veterinarian_sup.quote: 50 hours of on-the-job training under the supervision of a licensed veterinarian

scope_exclusions.quote: "Physical therapy" or "physiotherapy" does not include: (i) diagnosing disease; (ii) performing surgery; (iii) performing acupuncture; (iv) taking x-rays; or (v) prescribing or dispensing a drug, as defined in Section 58-37-2.

topical_drug_administration_authorized.quote: A licensed physical therapist may purchase, store, and administer: (a) topically applied medicinal agents, including steroids and analgesics, for wound care and for musculoskeletal treatment, using iontophoresis or phonorphoresis
topical_drug_administration_authorized.citation: Section 403 - Administration of a prescription drug.

aerosol_drug_administration_authorized.quote: aerosols for pulmonary hygiene in an institutional setting, if a licensed respiratory therapist is not available in, or within a 10 mile radius of, the institution.
aerosol_drug_administration_authorized.citation: Section 403 - Administration of a prescription drug.

drug_administration_requires_written_pre.quote: A licensed physical therapist may only purchase, store, or administer a medication described in this section pursuant to a written prescription issued by a practitioner who is licensed to prescribe that medication.
drug_administration_requires_written_pre.citation: Section 403 - Administration of a prescription drug.

interstate_compact_member.quote: The division may not issue a letter of qualification to participate in the Physical Therapy Licensure Compact until the criminal background check described in this section is completed.

compact_privilege_adverse_action_waiting.quote: Have not had any adverse action against any license or compact privilege within the previous 2 years

jurisprudence_exam_required_for_compact_.quote: Meet any jurisprudence requirements established by the remote state(s) in which the licensee is seeking a compact privilege

telehealth_consultation_exemption.quote: providing consultation by telecommunication to a physical therapist

visiting_practitioner_exemption_days.quote: teaching, demonstrating, or providing physical therapy in connection with an educational seminar, if the person engages in this conduct in Utah no more than 60 days per calendar year

internship_certification_required.quote: an individual may not engage in an internship in physical therapy, unless the person is: (i) certified by the division; or (ii) exempt from licensure under Section 58-24b-304.

pt_initial_evaluation_exclusive_to_pt.quote: perform the initial evaluation and documentation for each patient

protected_title_abbreviations.quote: It is unlawful for a person who is not a licensed physical therapist to: (a) except as provided in Subsection (6), use, in connection with the person's name or business, any of the following words or abbreviations: (i) physical therapist; (ii) physiotherapist; (iii) PT; (iv) DPT; (v) MPT
protected_title_abbreviations.citation: Section 503 - Lawful and unlawful use of titles and terms -- Unlawful advertising or promotion.
